g.text: End to end on merged main: each syscall saves about 75-80 ns; loses beyond ~69 calls or ~51 bytes of q-register copy

g.text: Time per outer iteration (one syscall plus n units of work). Integer loops win at every n; call-heavy and SIMD-copy work erodes the saving.
